aiFit.title: How you match: {{name}}
aiFit.intro: Score is tied to «{{name}}» guides: competitive GPA from ~{{cgpa}}, strong from ~{{sgpa}}/{{scale}}; UNT from ~{{unt}}; IELTS ≥ {{ielts}}. SAT counts only if you entered it (often optional in KZ). The result is capped by GPA—a high SAT won’t fix a weak average. {{note}}
aiFit.satExplainedNone: — fit uses GPA, UNT, and IELTS (typical without SAT).
aiFit.overviewNoKey: Add VITE_API_KEY to the environment—otherwise you’ll see a hint instead of Qwen.
aiFit.overviewEmpty: Overview not requested yet. Tap “Get Qwen overview” to generate text without auto-loading.

recommend.fitWithSat: Average AI Fit across programs at this university — {{pct}}% (using GPA, SAT, UNT, and interests).
recommend.fitNoSat: Average AI Fit across programs at this university — {{pct}}% (using GPA, UNT, and interests; SAT not set—normal for applications in Kazakhstan).
recommend.cityMatch: Your profile city (“{{city}}”) aligns well with the campus—edge when scores are close.
recommend.budgetOk: For funding and scholarships this university looks realistic: tuition guide {{band}}; the catalog lists strong scholarship options.
recommend.budgetWarn: Mind the cost: minimum guide {{band}}—check grants and your “need full support” status.
recommend.partial: For “partial scholarship,” this university falls in a typical price corridor for your profile.
recommend.selfPay: With self-payment you have a wider choice of programs; this university balances fit and cost well.
recommend.achievementBoost: Extracurricular signal feeds Fit: olympiad tier {{o}}, sports {{s}}, other merit {{m}}.
recommend.englishRisk: Note: with IELTS {{ielts}}, some programs may require English proof—check your chosen program.
